statement: Server DRAM prices are expected to rise 18% in Q3 2026, attributed to AI server demand outpacing supply additions.
why: A double-digit quarterly jump in server memory pricing is a direct read that memory supply is not keeping up with AI server build, and it raises the bill of materials for every accelerator system.

impact.mechanism: Rising server DRAM prices signal a tight memory market and lift AI server costs, squeezing system margins and constraining how much compute a fixed budget can buy.

evidence.excerpt: Server DRAM prices are expected to rise by 18% in Q3 2026,

confidence.basis: Forward expectation aggregated by one weekly newsletter from unnamed reporting dated 2026-07-17; it is a forecast, not a realised price, and the registered unit is year-over-year while the figure is quarterly.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 50.0 -> 18.0 (tol 1%); sources: OriginBrief - Semiconductor & Chip Industry Weekly
